newsitem.title: USA: Terra Nova establishes new Bermuda facility.
newsitem.headline: Terra Nova establishes new Bermuda facility.

text.p: Terra Nova (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it agreed to establish a Bermuda-based facility with Scandinavian Reinsurance Co Ltd that will provide financial guarantee insurance to owners and operators of vessels entering U.S. waters.
Scandinavian Reinsurance is authorized by the U.S. Coast Guard as an issuer of the financial guarantee insurance, Terra Nova said.
Scandinavian Reinsurance will issue the insurance coverage to the Coast Guard, which in turn will issue Certificates of Financial Responsibility to the ship owners and operators.

Terra Nova Underwriting Agency, a subsidiary of Terra Nova (Bermuda) Insurance Co Ltd, will be open to all brokers and will provide all marketing, underwriting and administration for the facility, Terra Nova said.
Scandinavian Reinsurance is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sirius International Insurance Corp of Sweden. The ultimate parent is ABB Asea Brown Boveri Ltd, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.
